mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.scenario_code, r.primary_connection_id, r.backup_connection_id, r.failover_enabled, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at, pc.name AS primary_connection_name, bc.name AS backup_connection_name

a.id, a.user_id, a.scenario_code, a.primary_connection_id, a.used_connection_id, a.backup_attempted, a.status, a.error_code, a.latency_ms, a.request_chars, a.response_chars, a.configuration_snapshot_json, a.created_at, a.finished_at, c.name AS used_connection_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_scenario_route r LEFT JOIN ai_connection pc ON pc.id = r.primary_connection_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection bc ON bc.id = r.backup_connection_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.scenario_code ASC

SELECT FROM ai_scenario_route r LEFT JOIN ai_connection pc ON pc.id = r.primary_connection_id LEFT JOIN ai_connection bc ON bc.id = r.backup_connection_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.scenario_code = #{scenarioCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_scenario_route SET primary_connection_id = #{primaryConnectionId}, backup_connection_id = #{backupConnectionId}, failover_enabled = #{failoverEnabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_scenario_route WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scenario_code = #{scenarioCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_call_audit SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, request_chars = #{requestChars}, response_chars = #{responseChars}, used_connection_id = #{usedConnectionId}, backup_attempted = #{backupAttempted}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
